description: This file is a header (.h) for WebSocket client functionality, defining data structures, function prototypes, and global variables related to WebSocket client management within a software project.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the WebSocket client.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_StartClient
methods.description: Starts a WebSocket client instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_StopClient
methods.description: Stops a specific WebSocket client instance.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_AllowConnect
methods.description: Allows the WebSocket client to initiate or accept connections.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_ActivateScheduledActions
methods.description: Activates scheduled actions for WebSocket client.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_QueueBinaryMessage
methods.description: Queues a binary message for sending over WebSocket.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_GetRetryCount
methods.description: Retrieves the number of retry attempts for a specific client.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_Main
methods.description: Main thread function for WebSocket client operation.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_IsEndpointConnected
methods.description: Checks if a specific endpoint is currently connected.
